Hi Jordan,

Great speaking earlier — thanks for the time. Per our chat I attached a lightweight mutual onboarding plan template and a short evaluation checklist you can use to scope the pilot. The goal is we align on milestones, owners, and a close target so procurement and engineering can plan.

What's in this initial package:
- MAP_template_v1.xlsx (milestones, owners, success criteria, dependencies)
- redwood-eval-checklist.pdf (short eval tests and sample prompts)
- Editable Google Doc for the shared MAP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c4d-redwood-veridian-map

Suggested next steps:
1) You and Aisha review template and add any missing stakeholders / constraints by Friday (Nov 27).
2) We (Redwood) propose a candidate timeline and resourcing plan on Monday (Nov 30).
3) Quick 30-min alignment call to finalize the MAP and sign off on the pilot scope.

If the timeline looks tight for your side, tell me what date range works and I'll adjust the Milestone column. I looped in Marissa (CS) for onboarding tasks and Aditya for commercial/contract questions.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scoped.

--

Priyom,

Thanks — this is helpful. Quick notes after a first pass with Aisha:
- The Milestone "Prod-like data ingestion" needs an owner on our side (we have a platform engineer but will confirm).
- Can we extend the pilot evaluation window by two weeks? We have a vendor security review the week of Dec 7 that could slow things down.
- We prefer the success criteria be measurable (example: 95th percentile latency < 250ms on 128-token test prompts). Can you add a column for "measurement method"?

Also: who owns the procurement paperwork? If we push to Dec 20-ish for signatures we'll need a procurement contact and an estimated SOW/price range to put on their internal tracker.

Would appreciate your proposed timeline reflecting the security review risk.

—Jordan

Regarding timeline: I moved the candidate sign-off date to Dec 17 to allow the week-of-Dec-7 security review to complete. The pilot evaluation window is now Dec 20 — Jan 10 (two weeks plus buffer). Please review the "Milestones" tab in the attached XLSX for dates.

Marissa — can you confirm what onboarding resources (kickoff, integration sessions, test harness access) we commit during the pilot?

If everyone agrees, can we lock a 30-min call next Tue (Dec 1) or Wed (Dec 2) to finalize? I added an event placeholder to the draft MAP comments.

Thanks,
Priyom
